comparison_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 3A - Provider Capabilities & Licensing Comparison

Tiingo.historical_capabilities: Complete daily EOD equity & ETF price history (30+ years), split-adjusted and unadjusted prices, cash dividends, corporate action metadata.
Tiingo.prospective_capabilities: Daily EOD bar publication ~5:30 PM EST; IEX intraday real-time top-of-book quotes; news feed.
Tiingo.point_in_time_integrity: High. Preserves historical split and dividend distributions with explicit ex-dates and adjustment factors.
Tiingo.reproducibility: Excellent for daily EOD bar research; deterministic endpoints.
Tiingo.api_availability_and_limits: REST API with JSON responses. Free: 500 requests/hr, 50 assets. Power: 20,000+ requests/hr.

licensing_terms.long_term_storage: CONDITIONALLY PERMITTED (internal analytics database allowed; public data warehousing prohibited)
licensing_terms.broker_simulation: PERMITTED (offline simulated order fill against EOD bars)

Tiingo.unresolved_ambiguities: Exact boundary on sharing derived research summaries vs raw prices in open-source academic publications.
Tiingo.justification: Optimal for offline daily EOD bar prospective evaluation. Low operational cost, robust corporate actions, verified non-professional terms.

Polygon_Massive.historical_capabilities: Tick-level, minute, and daily bar data from CTA/UTP consolidated tape (15+ years). Full corporate actions.
Polygon_Massive.prospective_capabilities: Consolidated SIP real-time stream, delayed feeds, REST and WebSocket endpoints.
Polygon_Massive.point_in_time_integrity: High. Official exchange consolidated tape records.
Polygon_Massive.reproducibility: Very high; comprehensive historical aggregates API.
Polygon_Massive.api_availability_and_limits: Unlimited API requests on paid developer tiers; rate-limited on free tier (5 req/min).

licensing_terms.long_term_storage: RESTRICTED (Terms explicitly prohibit bulk-scraping to build secondary permanent historical databases)
licensing_terms.redistribution: STRICTLY PROHIBITED (Commercial plan + exchange display fees required for any external display)

Polygon_Massive.unresolved_ambiguities: Distinction between allowable local backtest cache and prohibited bulk historical database construction.
Polygon_Massive.justification: Technically superior for intraday data, but higher monthly recurring cost ($29-$79/mo) than necessary for pure daily EOD evaluation.

Alpaca.tier_evaluated: Paper Trading API + Free / Algo Trader Plus ($0 - $9/mo)
Alpaca.historical_capabilities: 5+ years historical bars (IEX feed on free tier; full SIP on $9/mo Algo Trader Plus tier).
Alpaca.prospective_capabilities: Native simulated paper trading broker environment with simulated order fills, account balances, and real-time quotes.
Alpaca.point_in_time_integrity: Moderate (IEX feed lacks 100% consolidated tape volume; SIP upgrade required for full tape).
Alpaca.reproducibility: Moderate to High. Paper execution fills depend on simulated matching engine timing.
Alpaca.api_availability_and_limits: 200 requests/minute on free; higher on paid tiers.

licensing_terms.local_caching: PERMITTED (for local backtesting and model training)
licensing_terms.redistribution: STRICTLY PROHIBITED (Incorporates NASDAQ/NYSE subscriber agreements banning redistribution)

Alpaca.unresolved_ambiguities: Paper trading slippage model on leveraged ETFs (e.g., TQQQ, SOXL) does not model real market liquidity constraints during volatility spikes.
Alpaca.justification: Best suited if owner desires end-to-end broker order routing simulation rather than pure mathematical bar simulation.

Interactive_Brokers.tier_evaluated: TWS API / Client Portal API (US Equity Non-Professional ~$4.50/mo exchange fees)
Interactive_Brokers.historical_capabilities: Historical bars and ticks via TWS API; subject to strict pacing restrictions.
Interactive_Brokers.prospective_capabilities: Real-time Level 1 and Level 2 market data, paper trading accounts, comprehensive multi-asset routing.
Interactive_Brokers.point_in_time_integrity: Very High. Direct exchange data feeds with institutional grade corporate actions.
Interactive_Brokers.reproducibility: Moderate (TWS API requires running local TWS or IB Gateway software daemon).
Interactive_Brokers.api_availability_and_limits: Max 60 historical requests per 10-minute window; pacing violations trigger automatic cooldowns. Max 100 concurrent streaming lines.

licensing_terms.local_caching: RESTRICTED (Personal backtesting permitted; permanent database hoarding prohibited by exchange agreements)
licensing_terms.long_term_storage: RESTRICTED (Exchange rules prohibit building public historical quote archives)
licensing_terms.redistribution: STRICTLY PROHIBITED (Section 3 of Market Data Agreement: commercial exploitation/redistribution strictly banned)

Interactive_Brokers.unresolved_ambiguities: LRS (Liberalized Remittance Scheme) compliance and account minimums for Indian residents; TWS daily gateway restart disrupts automated unattended 24/7 scripts.
Interactive_Brokers.justification: Highest institutional fidelity but severe operational complexity (local TWS daemon, strict API pacing limits, cross-border funding hurdles).

comparative_summary.recommended_for_pure_data_evaluation: Tiingo (Lowest operational friction, clean corporate actions, flat rate, zero daemon required)
comparative_summary.recommended_for_paper_broker_simulation: Alpaca (Native paper trading API, REST endpoints, clean JSON orders)
comparative_summary.all_providers_license_constraint: ALL evaluated providers permit private single-user research but STRICTLY FORBID external redistribution or public hosting under personal plans.
